relevant_files.role: LanguageInfo struct definition and get_language_info() registry
Reference implementation for ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance
Minimal language integration example for wiring pattern
Test patterns and acceptance test structure

conventions.commits: Conventional Commits with types: feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore. All commits must be GPG-signed with --signoff flag. DCO required.
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language module files using AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert). Integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/. Test functions named test_<module>_<scenario>. Query validation tests required for ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and inheritance extraction.
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo deny check advisories licenses. Workspace lints: undocumented_unsafe_blocks=deny, unwrap_used=deny, expect_used=deny (with test exemptions).
conventions.error_handling: Use thiserror for error types. No unwrap() or expect() in production code paths. Bounds-check node byte ranges against source length before extracting text.

patterns: Language modules define ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as module-level &str constants containing tree-sitter query syntax
Extract handlers (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance) are optional functions that walk tree-sitter nodes and extract semantic information
LanguageInfo struct registered in get_language_info() match arm with all query and handler fields populated
Extension mapping in EXTENSION_MAP (lang.rs) and language name in get_language_info() and get_ts_language() must be synchronized
Defuse queries capture write sites (local declarations, assignments) and read sites (identifier usage) for dataflow analysis
Inheritance extraction walks node parent chain or uses field accessors (base_clause, class_interface_clause for PHP) to find extends/implements relationships

related_issues.title: add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php
related_issues.relevance: Primary issue requesting PHP language integration following the Java handler model

related_issues.relevance: Recent language expansion pattern showing minimal vs full handler implementations

related_issues.title: Knowledge Graph: structural module
related_issues.relevance: Shows how new languages integrate with structural graph for call analysis

constraints: PHP has no trait concept; only class, interface, enum, and function declarations are relevant
PHP inheritance uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as sibling nodes, not as fields of class_declaration
PHP method declarations are method_declaration nodes; functions are function_definition nodes (not method_declaration)
All tree-sitter-php node kinds and field names must be verified against the grammar's node-types.json before use in queries
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for PHP (used by semantic analysis and dataflow tools)
tree-sitter-php Rust crate must be added to workspace dependencies in Cargo.toml and imported in mod.rs
test_coverage: Existing language modules have 6-12 unit tests each covering: element query matching (classes, functions, methods), inheritance extraction (extends/implements), function name extraction, receiver type detection, method-for-receiver binding, defuse query write/read sites, and edge cases (empty files, nested structures). Integration tests in acceptance_tests.rs validate end-to-end parsing and semantic output. New PHP handler should follow this pattern with at least 9 test cases covering all declaration kinds and inheritance scenarios.

library_findings.notes: PHP grammar defines class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, function_definition, method_declaration nodes. Inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) sibling nodes, not fields. All node types and field names verified against https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/php/src/node-types.json
Used by all language handlers for parsing and querying. Query syntax supports captures (@name) and node type matching. Field accessors via node.child_by_field_name() used for semantic extraction.

approaches.name: Minimal PHP handler (CSS-style)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY (no DEFUSE_QUERY, no inheritance extraction). Register in mod.rs with minimal LanguageInfo. Add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP.
cons: Incomplete semantic analysis compared to Java/Kotlin
Does not meet issue requirements which model after Java (full handler)

approaches.name: Full PHP handler (Java-style, recommended)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants. Implement extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance handlers. Register in mod.rs with all LanguageInfo fields. Add tree-sitter-php to workspace dependencies. Add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP. Include 9+ unit tests.
pros: Complete semantic analysis (inheritance, dataflow, call graphs)
Follows issue requirement to model after Java handler
Enables full knowledge graph and structural analysis
cons: Requires careful tree-sitter query crafting for PHP grammar

approaches.name: Phased PHP handler (minimal + full in follow-up)
approaches.description: Ship minimal handler in this PR (ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY only). Follow up with full handler PR adding DEFUSE_QUERY, inheritance extraction, and handlers in a second iteration.
pros: Reduces risk of single large PR
Allows feedback on minimal queries before full implementation
cons: Issue requirement explicitly asks for Java-style full handler
Leaves semantic analysis incomplete until follow-up

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP handler, Java-style). The issue explicitly asks to 'model after java.rs', which is a full handler with DEFUSE_QUERY and extract_inheritance. This approach delivers complete semantic analysis, enables knowledge graph integration, and aligns with the project's trajectory toward richer multi-language support. The medium complexity is justified by the requirement and the precedent set by Kotlin, C#, and Swift handlers. Implementation effort is ~2-3 hours for an experienced contributor.

(

(
  assignment_expression
    left: (list_literal (variable_name) @write.list))
(

    value: (variable_name) @write.foreach)
(
  foreach_statement
    key: (variable_name) @write.foreach)
(
  catch_clause

(
  variable_name) @read.usage
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php/blob/master/common/define-grammar.js): class_declaration node has optional sibling nodes base_clause (for extends) and class_interface_clause (for implements). Walk: (1) class_declaration node -> (2) iterate children for base_clause node -> (3) extract _name children as extends targets; (4) iterate children for class_interface_clause node -> (5) extract _name children as implements targets. Field names do not exist; base_clause and class_interface_clause are unnamed children matched by kind(), not by field_name().

wiring_summary.workspace_dependency: Add tree-sitter-php to [workspace.dependencies] in Cargo.toml with version matching tree-sitter-php crate release (e.g., 0.21.0 or latest).
wiring_summary.core_cargo_dependency: Add tree-sitter-php = { workspace = true } to [dependencies] in crates/aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml.
wiring_summary.mod_rs_declaration: Add pub mod php; to crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/mod.rs at line ~12 (alphabetically after markdown, before python).
wiring_summary.language_info_match_arm: Add match arm in get_language_info() function: "php" => Some(LanguageInfo { name: "php", language: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP.into(), element_query: php::ELEMENT_QUERY, call_query: php::CALL_QUERY, reference_query: Some(php::REFERENCE_QUERY), import_query: Some(php::IMPORT_QUERY), impl_query: None, impl_trait_query: None, defuse_query: Some(php::DEFUSE_QUERY), extract_function_name: Some(php::extract_function_name), find_method_for_receiver: Some(php::find_method_for_receiver), find_receiver_type: Some(php::find_receiver_type), extract_inheritance: Some(php::extract_inheritance), }).
wiring_summary.get_ts_language_match_arm: Add match arm in get_ts_language() function: "php" => Some(tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP.into()).
wiring_summary.extension_map_entry: Add ("php", "php") entry to EXTENSION_MAP in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/lang.rs (alphabetically after "mjs", before "py").
wiring_summary.supported_languages_array: Add "php" to the &[&'static str] returned by supported_languages() in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/lang.rs (alphabetically after "markdown", before "python").
